customer: Hello, I traded in my midsize SUV with Northwind recently, and I believe my regular loan payment went through to my lender right around the time your payoff did. Could you tell me how I get that extra payment back? As a veteran on a fixed budget, I'd appreciate knowing what to expect. Thank you for your help.
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and for your service. As our article "Getting back an extra loan payment" explains, when your lender receives both our payoff and one of your regular payments, the extra amount belongs to you, and your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward overpayments, so if the refund doesn't arrive, please contact your lender directly.
